The home mountain of the Greek Gods is Mount Olympus.

To understand how search engines work, imagine the Internet as a massive, endless library. In this analogy, entire websites are like individual books, and the specific web pages within those sites are the pages inside those books. Just as a library uses an index card system or a digital catalog to help you locate the exact book and page you need, search engines like Google act as that intelligent index. They scan the "library" of the Internet so you can quickly find the specific information you are looking for without having to read every single book from cover to cover.
